summary: Iteration 5 - Comprehensive testing of P1/P2 features (AI Search, Admin Slack Panel, Tour). All backend tests PASSED (15/15). All frontend UI tests PASSED. Fixed critical frontend bug in Integrations.jsx (missing icon mappings).
